notifications.quietNote: Critical alerts override quiet hours and ring at full volume.
notifications.explainerBody: A master mute means someone mutes it before sleeping and misses a real escalation. No control at all means admins disable notifications at the OS level and lose everything. Locking only the critical tier is the configuration that survives both.

support.title: Help & support

faq.reassignQ: How do I reassign a stuck booking?
faq.reassignA: Open the booking and use Re-dispatch. That re-runs the automation with a wider radius — it does not let you hand-pick a provider, because the ranking is what finds someone who will actually accept. If three rounds still fail the booking escalates, and you assign manually from the escalation banner.
faq.manualQ: When should I use manual completion?
faq.manualA: Only when the customer confirms the work is done and the completion OTP cannot be produced. It needs evidence, a reason code and a logged call attempt, and it produces a visibly different state — Completed (Admin Verified) — which the customer is told about and may dispute.
faq.escalationQ: Why did the system escalate this booking?
faq.escalationA: Assignment is automated. After three dispatch rounds with no acceptance, or once the promised window is breached, the booking escalates to a human. The alert detail names which rule fired.
faq.suspendQ: What happens when I suspend a provider?
faq.suspendA: They stop receiving new dispatches immediately. Jobs already in progress are listed before you confirm so none is orphaned, and the suspension is reversible within the undo window.
faq.refundQ: How do refunds affect provider payouts?
faq.refundA: A refund creates an adjustment against the provider's next settlement cycle. The adjustment is visible on the payouts screen on desktop, alongside the booking it came from.
faq.lostPhoneQ: I lost my phone — what now?
faq.lostPhoneA: Sign in from any browser, revoke the device under Security & devices, change your password, then ask your Super Admin to review the audit log for anything done from that device.
